stage: FQ3 formal retrospective robustness and visible crossing

state_slice.measure: nanoseconds elapsed between the first and last state in the same 32-event causal window
state_slice.threshold: per-stock median of positive duration on the frozen Jan-March 200k training endpoints
state_slice.high_activity: positive duration strictly below the frozen training median
state_slice.low_activity: duration at or above the frozen training median
state_slice.undefined: nonpositive duration or fewer than three scored rows in stock/day/slice

updated_models.comparison: updated and fixed models on exactly matched original-event rows and targets

execution.entry: visible ask for positive prediction and bid for negative prediction at t
execution.exit: opposite visible quote at original event t+20 in the same segment
execution.unit: one share per selected opportunity, zero delay, no fees/impact/inventory/fills
execution.primary_sequence_action: arithmetic mean of the three fixed 200k GRU seed predictions
execution.common_opportunity: same FQ2 200k scoring event IDs with finite current and t+20 spread and midpoint label

lo_so: not run without a separate source-only inner chronological tuning contract
exposure: all evaluated 2017 dates previously inspected; diagnostic only
